<# Desempenho extra: hibernação/Fast Startup, indexação de busca, DiagTrack, SysMain,
   Delivery Optimization, Windows Error Reporting, tarefas de telemetria/CEIP,
   apps em segundo plano, timestamp de último acesso do NTFS, telemetria (política),
   Activity Feed/Timeline, Recall/AI e caminhos longos. #>

powercfg.exe /hibernate off;
reg.exe add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Power" /v HiberbootEnabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f;

reg.exe add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\DiagTrack" /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f;

$isHdd = $false;
try {
	$isHdd = ( Get-Partition -DriveLetter 'C' | Get-Disk | Get-PhysicalDisk ).MediaType -eq 'HDD';
} catch {}
if( $isHdd ) {
	reg.exe add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\WSearch" /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f;
	reg.exe add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\SysMain" /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f;
}

reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DeliveryOptimization" /v DODownloadMode /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f;

reg.exe add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\WerSvc" /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f;
reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting" /v Disabled /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f;

reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\AppPrivacy" /v LetAppsRunInBackground /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f;

fsutil.exe behavior set disablelastaccess 1;

reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection" /v AllowTelemetry /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f;

reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System" /v EnableActivityFeed /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f;
reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System" /v PublishUserActivities /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f;
reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System" /v UploadUserActivities /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f;

reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsAI" /v DisableAIDataAnalysis /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f;

reg.exe add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem" /v LongPathsEnabled /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f;

reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer" /v HideRecommendedSection /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f;
reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer" /v DisableSuggestedActions /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f;

reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent" /v DisableTailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticData /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f;
reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Search" /v EnableDynamicContentInWSB /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f;
reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection" /v DoNotShowFeedbackNotifications /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f;


$servicesToDisable = @(
	'XblAuthManager';
	'XblGameSave';
	'XboxNetApiSvc';
	'XboxGipSvc';
	'RetailDemo';
	'MapsBroker';
	'WalletService';
	'diagnosticshub.standardcollector.service';
	'WMPNetworkSvc';
	'PhoneSvc';
	'SEMgrSvc';
	'wisvc';
	'RemoteRegistry';
);
foreach( $svc in $servicesToDisable ) {
	reg.exe add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\$svc" /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f;
}

$tasks = @(
	'\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser';
	'\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\ProgramDataUpdater';
	'\Microsoft\Windows\Autochk\Proxy';
	'\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\Consolidator';
	'\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\UsbCeip';
	'\Microsoft\Windows\DiskDiagnostic\Microsoft-Windows-DiskDiagnosticDataCollector';
	'\Microsoft\Windows\Feedback\Siuf\DmClient';
	'\Microsoft\Windows\Feedback\Siuf\DmClientOnScenarioDownload';
);
foreach( $task in $tasks ) {
	schtasks.exe /Change /TN $task /Disable *> $null;
}

<Configuration> <Add OfficeClientEdition="64" Channel="Current"> <Product ID="O365ProPlusRetail"> <Language ID="pt-br" /> <ExcludeApp ID="Access" /> <ExcludeApp ID="Groove" /> <ExcludeApp ID="Lync" /> <ExcludeApp ID="OneDrive" /> <ExcludeApp ID="OneNote" /> <ExcludeApp ID="Outlook" /> <ExcludeApp ID="Publisher" /> <ExcludeApp ID="Teams" /> <ExcludeApp ID="Bing" /> </Product> </Add> <Updates Enabled="TRUE" /> <Display Level="None" AcceptEULA="TRUE" /> </Configuration>

<# Instala apenas Word, Excel e PowerPoint (sem Access, Outlook, OneNote, Publisher,
   Teams, OneDrive) via Office Deployment Tool, SEM licença/ativação. A ativação fica
   por conta de quem receber a máquina (Configurações > Conta > Ativar Office).
   Produto padrão: O365ProPlusRetail (licenciamento por assinatura Microsoft 365) no
   Channel "Current". Se o destino usar uma chave perpétua do Office 2021/2024, troque
   o ID do produto aqui embaixo (ex.: 'HomeBusinessRetail' ou 'ProfessionalRetail') e o
   Channel em OfficeConfiguration.xml para 'PerpetualVL2021' ou 'PerpetualVL2024'. #>

$logfile = 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\unattend-05.log';
& {
	function Test-OfficeInstalled {
		Test-Path -LiteralPath "${env:ProgramFiles}\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\WINWORD.EXE";
	}

	if( Test-OfficeInstalled ) {
		'Office já instalado, nada a fazer.';
		return;
	}

	$odtDir = 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\ODT';
	New-Item -Path $odtDir -ItemType 'Directory' -Force -ErrorAction 'SilentlyContinue' | Out-Null;
	$setup = $null;

	$winget = Get-Command -Name 'winget.exe' -ErrorAction 'SilentlyContinue';
	if( $winget ) {
		try {
			& $winget.Source install --id 'Microsoft.OfficeDeploymentTool' --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements --location $odtDir *> $null;
		} catch {
			$_;
		}
		$setup = Get-ChildItem -Path @( $odtDir; "${env:ProgramFiles}\OfficeDeploymentTool"; "${env:LOCALAPPDATA}\Microsoft\WinGet\Packages" ) -Filter 'setup.exe' -Recurse -ErrorAction 'SilentlyContinue' | Select-Object -First 1;
	}

	if( -not $setup ) {
		try {
			$uri = [uri]::new( 'https://download.microsoft.com/download/6c1eeb25-cf8b-41d9-8d0d-cc1dbc032140/officedeploymenttool_20228-20124.exe' );
			$instalador = "$env:TEMP\{0}" -f $uri.Segments[-1];
			[System.Net.WebClient]::new().DownloadFile( $uri, $instalador );
			Start-Process -FilePath $instalador -ArgumentList '/quiet', "/extract:$odtDir" -Wait;
			Remove-Item -LiteralPath $instalador -ErrorAction 'SilentlyContinue';
			$setup = Get-ChildItem -Path $odtDir -Filter 'setup.exe' -Recurse -ErrorAction 'SilentlyContinue' | Select-Object -First 1;
		} catch {
			$_;
		}
	}

	if( -not $setup ) {
		'Office Deployment Tool não pôde ser obtido (winget indisponível/falhou e download direto falhou); Office não foi instalado.';
		return;
	}

	Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\OfficeConfiguration.xml' -Destination ( Join-Path $setup.DirectoryName 'OfficeConfiguration.xml' ) -Force;
	Start-Process -FilePath $setup.FullName -ArgumentList '/configure', 'OfficeConfiguration.xml' -WorkingDirectory $setup.DirectoryName -Wait;

	if( Test-OfficeInstalled ) {
		'Office instalado com sucesso (sem ativação).';
	} else {
		'Falha ao instalar o Office; verifique a conexão com a internet durante a instalação.';
	}
} *>&1 | Out-String -Width 1KB -Stream >> $logfile;
